sentences.en: An opponent of limited dimensions can often be quite diverting.
sentences.zh: 一个尺寸有限的对手往往很有趣。

sentences.en: Go on with your story; I'm vastly diverted by it!
sentences.zh: 继续讲吧；这个故事让我非常着迷！

sentences.en: The producers of Spanish strawberries divert water from natural reserves.
sentences.zh: 西班牙草莓生产商从天然储备中抽取水资源。
